newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario Teachers in group buying MacBlo shrs.
newsitem.headline: Ontario Teachers in group buying MacBlo shrs.

text.p: Ontario Teachers' Pension Board Plan said on Monday that it is part of a group which acquired 3.8 million shares in Vancouver-based MacMillan Bloedel Ltd between February 5 and March 21.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the shares at prices ranging between C$12.71 and C$13.95 per share.
The Teachers' share of the purchase was not disclosed, said Lee Fullerton, manager of communications for the Teachers' board.
The shares were acquired by an investment company owned by Thomas Taylor which invests on behalf of the Teachers' and the Bass Family of Fort Worth, Texas, Fullerton said.
The group now holds a total of 11.8 million shares or a 9.5 percent stake in MacMillan Bloedel.
MacMillan Bloedel's stock was up 0.05 at 19.30 on 701,000 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
